experiment_data.hypothesis: Closed-source frontier models (GPT-4o, Claude, etc.) also exhibit symbolic confirmation bias when self-extracting FOL constraints. If SCB persists at frontier scale with different architectures, this strengthens the claim that SCB is a fundamental property of self-verification rather than a scale or architecture artifact.
